tasks.taskName: Apply prioritization framework to rank items

steps.title: Confirm the ranking scope covers all Ready items in Jira
sop: Open the Backlog view of the team's Scrum board in Jira and filter the backlog by status Ready
Save the filtered result as the ranking list for the cycle
Compare the list against the candidate work slated for the next 2-3 sprints on the roadmap view
Add any missing candidate item to the ranking list
Done when every Ready item for the next 2-3 sprints appears on the ranking list
verify: Open the Jira backlog, apply the same status Ready filter and compare the results to the ranking list
Pass when every Ready item appears on the ranking list

steps.title: Enter the business value score on each Ready item in Jira
sop: Open the saved ranking list filter in Jira and open the first Ready item
Enter the agreed relative score in the WSJF Business Value field and save
Repeat for every remaining item on the ranking list
Done when every Ready item has a business value score recorded
verify: Open the ranking list in Jira and add the WSJF Business Value column to the list view
Scan the column for blank cells
Pass when no Ready item is missing a business value score

steps.title: Enter the time criticality score on each Ready item in Jira
sop: Open the saved ranking list filter in Jira and open the first Ready item
Enter the agreed relative score in the WSJF Time Criticality field and save
Repeat for every remaining item on the ranking list
Done when every Ready item has a time criticality score recorded
verify: Open the ranking list in Jira and add the WSJF Time Criticality column to the list view
Scan the column for blank cells
Pass when no Ready item is missing a time criticality score

steps.title: Enter the risk reduction score on each Ready item in Jira
sop: Open the saved ranking list filter in Jira and open the first Ready item
Enter the agreed relative score in the WSJF Risk Reduction field and save
Repeat for every remaining item on the ranking list
Done when every Ready item has a risk reduction score recorded
verify: Open the ranking list in Jira and add the WSJF Risk Reduction column to the list view
Scan the column for blank cells
Pass when no Ready item is missing a risk reduction score

steps.title: Enter the job size estimate on each Ready item in Jira
sop: Open the saved ranking list filter in Jira and open the first Ready item
Enter the agreed relative estimate in the WSJF Job Size field and save
Repeat for every remaining item on the ranking list
Done when 0 items remain without a job size estimate
verify: Run a JQL filter in Jira for status Ready items with an empty Job Size field
Pass when the filter returns 0 items

steps.title: Compute the WSJF score on each Ready item in Jira
sop: Open the WSJF report view for the ranking cycle in Jira
Run the WSJF calculation so each item's score computes from its four component fields
Confirm the computed score stores on each item's WSJF field
Done when 100% of Ready items carry a stored WSJF score
verify: Open a sample of Ready items in Jira and recompute each WSJF score from the four component fields
Compare each recomputed score to the stored WSJF field value
Pass when 100% of sampled items match

steps.title: Resolve ranking ties among the top 10 items in Jira
sop: Open the ranking list in Jira and sort it by the WSJF score column descending
Identify any tied scores within the top 10 positions
Reorder the tied items by dragging them into rank order using the agreed secondary criterion
Done when the top 10 ordering is a strict total order with no ties
verify: Sort the ranking list by WSJF score in Jira and read the top 10 positions
Pass when no two items share a rank

steps.title: Flag items lacking WSJF inputs as Needs Refinement in Jira
sop: Run a JQL filter in Jira for ranking-list items with any empty WSJF component field
Apply the Needs Refinement label to each result from the item's detail panel
Drag each labelled item out of the ranked order so it holds no rank
Done when every incomplete item is excluded from ranking until inputs are complete
verify: Run the same JQL filter in Jira for items missing a WSJF input
Pass when every result carries the Needs Refinement flag and no rank

steps.title: Record the rationale for any priority override in the item comments in Jira
sop: Open the ranking list in Jira and compare each item's position to its WSJF score order
Open each item ranked out of its WSJF order
Add a comment on the item explaining the override rationale and save
Done when every overridden item carries a rationale comment
verify: Sort the ranking list by WSJF score in Jira and list items whose rank departs from score order
Open each and read its comments
Pass when each carries a Product Owner rationale comment

steps.title: Export the ranked order snapshot to the planning page in Confluence
sop: Open the final ranked order view in Jira
Export the ranked list from the view's Export menu
Open the cycle's planning page in Confluence and paste the snapshot with a timestamp
Publish the page
Done when a timestamped snapshot of the prioritized order is published for the cycle
verify: Open the cycle's planning page in Confluence
Pass when a snapshot with a timestamp exists

steps.title: Reconcile the ranked item count to the Ready item count in Jira
sop: Open the ranking list in Jira and read its item count from the view footer
Run a JQL filter for status Ready on the board and read that count
Compare the two counts and resolve any gap by adding or removing items
Done when the two counts match exactly
verify: Count the ranked list and the status Ready filter results separately in Jira
Pass when the delta is 0

steps.title: Record the Product Owner sign-off on the ranked backlog in Jira
sop: Open the finished ranked backlog for the cycle in Jira
Review the order against the WSJF scores and the override comments
Add a sign-off comment on the ranking record naming the cycle
Done when the ranked backlog for the cycle is published with a sign-off comment
verify: Open the ranking record in Jira and read its comments
Pass when the Product Owner sign-off comment is present

tasks.taskName: Apply version control to documentation set

steps.title: Open a pull request for the reviewed documentation set in GitHub Enterprise
sop: Open the docs repository in GitHub Enterprise and create a new branch for the reviewed set
Push the branch and open a pull request targeting main from the Pull requests tab
Confirm no reviewed doc change is committed directly to main
Done when no reviewed doc is committed directly to main
verify: Open the commit history on main for the docs repository in GitHub Enterprise
Pass when the docs changes exist on a PR branch rather than direct commits to main

steps.title: Commit each reviewed document to the docs repo in GitHub Enterprise
sop: Open the PR branch of the docs repository in GitHub Enterprise
Commit every document on the review list to the branch
Refresh the PR's Files changed tab and tick off each review-list document as it appears
Done when every reviewed document appears in the PR changeset
verify: Open the PR's Files changed tab in GitHub Enterprise and compare it to the review list
Pass when no reviewed doc is missing from the changeset

steps.title: Apply the release version tag to the docs commit in GitHub Enterprise
sop: Open the docs commit on the PR branch in GitHub Enterprise and copy its commit SHA
Open the Tags page on the repository and create the release version tag pointing at that SHA
Done when the docs commit carries the release tag
verify: Open the Tags page on the repository in GitHub Enterprise
Pass when the release tag points at the docs commit

steps.title: Record the author on each committed document in GitHub Enterprise
sop: Open the Commits tab of the docs PR in GitHub Enterprise
Open each document's commit and read the author line in the commit header
Ask any author with missing or misattributed metadata to amend and re-push the commit
Done when each committed doc shows its author in the commit metadata
verify: Open the Commits tab of the docs PR in GitHub Enterprise
Pass when each doc commit names an author

steps.title: Link the release change ticket on the pull request in GitHub Enterprise
sop: Open the docs PR in GitHub Enterprise and click Edit on the description
Paste the release change ticket link into the description and save
Click the link to confirm it resolves
Done when the PR description references the release change ticket
verify: Open the PR description in GitHub Enterprise and click the change ticket link
Pass when the change ticket link resolves

steps.title: Record excluded documents with reasons in the PR description in GitHub Enterprise
sop: Open the docs PR in GitHub Enterprise and click Edit on the description
Add an Exclusions section listing each intentionally excluded document
Record the reason next to each entry such as superseded and save
Done when every exclusion carries a reason
verify: Read the Exclusions section of the PR description in GitHub Enterprise
Pass when every exclusion carries a reason

steps.title: Reconcile the reviewed-doc list against the repo tree in GitHub Enterprise
sop: Open the review list on the docs review page in Confluence and count the documents
Open the PR's Files changed tab in GitHub Enterprise and count the committed documents
Compare the two counts and commit any missing document to the branch
Done when the reconciliation shows 0 gaps between reviewed docs and committed docs
verify: Compare the reviewed-doc list to the PR's Files changed tab in GitHub Enterprise
Pass when the counts are equal

steps.title: Confirm the docs build passes on the PR in GitHub Actions
sop: Open the docs PR in GitHub Enterprise and select the Checks tab
Open the docs-build workflow run in GitHub Actions
Fix any reported errors and re-run the job until it passes
Done when the docs-build check on the PR is green
verify: Open the Checks tab on the PR and read the docs-build run status in GitHub Actions
Pass when the docs-build run finished green

steps.title: Confirm prior versions are retrievable from history in GitHub Enterprise
sop: Open a sampled document in the docs repository in GitHub Enterprise and click History
Select an earlier commit and open that version of the document
Confirm the prior content renders
Done when a prior version of a sampled doc can be opened from git history
verify: Open the same sampled document's History in GitHub Enterprise and open an earlier version
Pass when an earlier version opens successfully

steps.title: Record the Tech Lead approval on the pull request in GitHub Enterprise
sop: Open the docs PR in GitHub Enterprise and click Reviewers in the right-hand panel
Request review from the Tech Lead
Hold the PR unmerged until the approval appears in the review panel
Done when the Tech Lead approval appears on the PR before merge
verify: Open the Reviews section of the PR in GitHub Enterprise
Pass when an approval by the Tech Lead is present
